title: Selective Surface Processing on Cutting Tool
content: In manufacturing, surface hardening of tools is essential to improve their performance and prolong their service life. One of the most prominent techniques for this purpose is the thermochemical boriding treatment, which increases the wear resistance, surface hardness and the ability to withstand high temperatures of ferrous and non-ferrous materials [1-2-3-4]. However, the selective boriding technique, which allows treating only the critical areas of a part, has been little explored at the scientific and industrial level. [5-6-7-8]
